description.value: Ramie's Greek Restaurant is a family-owned establishment celebrating 25 years of serving Greek cuisine, with its second location on Highway 17A in Delta. The original Burnaby location earned the Quality Business Award for Best Greek Restaurant in both 2023 and 2024. The Delta outpost brings the same menu — including lunch, dinner, liquor, and happy hour offerings — to a Highway 17A corridor that sees significant cycling traffic.
